# SpeexDSP (vendored subset)

The SpeexDSP preprocessor (noise suppression + AGC) by Jean-Marc Valin and the Xiph.Org Foundation, from https://github.com/xiph/speexdsp at tag `SpeexDSP-1.2.1`. BSD-3-Clause: see [`COPYING`](COPYING). Unlike Codec 2 (LGPL), the licence is fine for the product.

Only the preprocessor and what it links are here, unmodified:

- `libspeexdsp/`: `preprocess.c`, `filterbank.c`, `fftwrap.c`, `smallft.c` and the headers they include (`arch.h`, `filterbank.h`, `fftwrap.h`, `smallft.h`, `math_approx.h`, `os_support.h`).
- `include/speex/`: `speex_preprocess.h`, `speex_echo.h`, `speexdsp_types.h`.

Re-vendor by copying those files from the tag's `libspeexdsp/` and `include/speex/`.

## Port files (Project-Blue-Frog)

- `port/config.h`: what upstream's configure would generate. Float build (the AGC exists only there), Speex's own `smallft` FFT, warnings off.
- `port/os_support_custom.h`: every allocation comes from a static arena in `src/tdma_console/mic_dsp.c`, rebuilt at each run's start, so the state never touches a heap. Fatal errors `k_oops()`.
- `port/float_math.h`: force-included. It maps the double-precision libm calls in the float build (`exp`, `log`, `pow`, `sqrt`, ...) to their float versions. The M33's FPU is single precision, and with the doubles the preprocessor took 10.7 ms per 20 ms frame; with this header it takes about 1.7 ms.
- `port/echo_stub.c`: `preprocess.c` calls `speex_echo_get_residual()` (in `mdf.c`, the echo canceller) whenever an echo state is attached. None ever is, since the earpieces have no acoustic path back to the mics. The stub keeps the symbol resolvable without linking the echo canceller.
- `include/speex/speexdsp_config_types.h`: the `stdint` types, normally generated by configure.

Linked only into builds with `CONFIG_SOAK_MIC_DSP`; see `docs/mic_dsp_frontend.md`.
